craftsmanship_gate.strongest_counterargument: More sensitive legal warnings can alarm customers when jurisdiction is unresolved. The design therefore raises customer visibility without raising the legal claim state: POSSIBLE_LEGAL_REVIEW remains distinct from an assessed legal defect.
craftsmanship_gate.failure_mode_chain: Impressum sidecar detects strong provider opacity -> generic projection or Core-only relevance gate loses it -> top-four report omits it -> customer reads omission as reassurance. Controls: central legal_customer_projection resolver, non-core legal evidence route, mandatory top-four rank, cover/roadmap/closing propagation and end-to-end omission gate.
notes: The exact 48-metric Core score, coverage, weights and compute_score.py remain unchanged.
Unresolved jurisdiction remains POSSIBLE_LEGAL_REVIEW and is never rewritten as a proven legal violation.
The customer warning can be MANDATORY_CRITICAL while legal claim certainty remains unresolved.
Expected fines, automatic GDPR conclusions and definitive illegality wording remain blocked.
LEGAL-IMP-* remains non-core and has NONE_DIRECT score impact.
The user preference for stronger warnings was not implemented as automatic violation claims.
Alarmism is controlled by separating customer-risk priority from legal claim state and by negative overclaim tests.

mitigations: false-negative bias: mandatory observed provider-opacity risks cannot be omitted
false-positive/alarmism bias: unresolved applicability cannot become a definitive violation
severity inflation bias: customer priority is separate from finding/legal certainty
score contamination bias: Legal sidecar remains outside the 48-metric Core
